processed_hadiths.english_translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled regarding a fetus that is killed in its mother's womb with a ghurrah (compensation) of a male or female slave. The one who was ruled against said: 'How can I pay compensation for one who did not drink, nor eat, nor speak, nor cry out? Such a one should be considered worthless.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'This is one of the brothers of the soothsayers.'

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Malik, from Rabi'ah ibn Abi Abd al-Rahman, that he used to say: 'The ghurrah is valued at fifty dinars or six hundred dirhams, and the diya (blood money) of a free Muslim woman is five hundred dinars or six thousand dirhams.' Malik said: 'The diya of the fetus of a free woman is one-tenth of her diya, and one-tenth is fifty dinars or six hundred dirhams.' Malik said: 'I have not heard anyone differ that the ghurrah is not required for the fetus until it separates from its mother's womb and falls from her belly dead.' Malik said: 'And I have heard that if the fetus exits from its mother's womb alive and then dies, the full diya is required.' Malik said: 'There is no life for the fetus except by crying out (istihla'l). So if it exits from its mother's womb and cries out, then dies, the full diya is required. And we see that in the fetus of a slave woman is one-tenth of her mother's price.' Malik said: 'And if a woman kills a man or a woman intentionally while she is pregnant, qisas (retaliation) is not taken from her until she delivers her child. And if a pregnant woman is killed intentionally or by mistake, there is nothing upon the one who killed her regarding her fetus. If she was killed intentionally, the one who killed her is killed, and there is no diya for her fetus. And if she was killed by mistake, upon the 'aqilah (male relatives) of her killer is her diya, and there is no diya for her fetus.' Yahya narrated to me: Malik was asked about the fetus of a Jewish or Christian woman that is miscarried. He said: 'I see that in it is one-tenth of her mother's diya.'
processed_hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي، عَنْ مَالِك، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: الْغُرَّةُ تُقَوَّمُ خَمْسِينَ دِينَارًا أَوْ سِتَّ مِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ، وَدِيَةُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحُرَّةِ الْمُسْلِمَةِ خَمْسُ مِائَةِ دِينَارٍ أَوْ سِتَّةُ آلَافِ دِرْهَمٍ. قَالَ مَالِك: فَدِيَةُ جَنِينِ الْحُرَّةِ عُشْرُ دِيَتِهَا وَالْعُشْرُ خَمْسُونَ دِينَارًا أَوْ سِتُّ مِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ. قَالَ مَالِك: وَلَمْ أَسْمَعْ أَحَدًا يُخَالِفُ فِي أَنَّ الْجَنِينَ لَا تَكُونُ فِيهِ الْغُرَّةُ حَتَّى يُزَايِلَ بَطْنَ أُمِّهِ وَيَسْقُطُ مِنْ بَطْنِهَا مَيِّتًا. قَالَ مَالِك: وَسَمِعْتُ أَنَّهُ إِذَا خَرَجَ الْجَنِينُ مِنْ بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ حَيًّا ثُمَّ مَاتَ أَنَّ فِيهِ الدِّيَةَ كَامِلَةً. قَالَ مَالِك: وَلَا حَيَاةَ لِلْجَنِينِ إِلَّا بِالْاسْتِهْلَالِ، فَإِذَا خَرَجَ مِنْ بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ فَاسْتَهَلَّ ثُمَّ مَاتَ، فَفِيهِ الدِّيَةُ كَامِلَةً، وَنَرَى أَنَّ فِي جَنِينِ الْأَمَةِ عُشْرَ ثَمَنِ أُمِّهِ. قَالَ مَالِك: وَإِذَا قَتَلَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ رَجُلًا أَوِ امْرَأَةً عَمْدًا وَالَّتِي قَتَلَتْ حَامِلٌ، لَمْ يُقَدْ مِنْهَا حَتَّى تَضَعَ حَمْلَهَا، وَإِنْ قُتِلَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ وَهِيَ حَامِلٌ عَمْدًا أَوْ خَطَأً فَلَيْسَ عَلَى مَنْ قَتَلَهَا فِي جَنِينِهَا شَيْءٌ، فَإِنْ قُتِلَتْ عَمْدًا قُتِلَ الَّذِي قَتَلَهَا وَلَيْسَ فِي جَنِينِهَا دِيَةٌ، وَإِنْ قُتِلَتْ خَطَأً فَعَلَى عَاقِلَةِ قَاتِلِهَا دِيَتُهَا وَلَيْسَ فِي جَنِينِهَا دِيَةٌ. وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، سُئِلَ مَالِك عَنْ جَنِينِ الْيَهُودِيَّةِ وَالنَّصْرَانِيَّةِ يُطْرَحُ؟ فَقَالَ: أَرَى أَنَّ فِيهِ عُشْرَ دِيَةِ أُمِّهِ

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Malik said: 'I asked Ibn Shihab about a one-eyed man who blinds the eye of a sound person.' Ibn Shihab said: 'If the sound person wishes to have retaliation (qisas) from him, he has qisas. And if he wishes, he has the diya: one thousand dinars or twelve thousand dirhams.' Yahya narrated to me from Malik that it reached him: That for every pair from the human being is the full diya, and that for the tongue is the full diya, and that for the two ears if their hearing goes is the full diya, whether they are cut off or not cut off, and for the man's penis is the full diya, and for the two testicles is the full diya. Yahya narrated to me from Malik that it reached him: That for the two breasts of a woman is the full diya. Malik said: 'The lightest of that in my view are the two eyebrows and the two breasts of a man.' Malik said: 'The matter with us is: That if a man is injured in his limbs more than his diya, that is for him - if his two hands and his two feet and his two eyes are injured, he has three diyas.' Malik said regarding the sound eye of a one-eyed man if it is blinded by mistake: 'In it is the full diya.'
processed_hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ مَالِك، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ الْأَعْوَرِ يَفْقَأُ عَيْنَ الصَّحِيحِ؟ فَقَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ: إِنْ أَحَبَّ الصَّحِيحُ أَنْ يَسْتَقِيدَ مِنْهُ فَلَهُ الْقَوَدُ، وَإِنْ أَحَبَّ فَلَهُ الدِّيَةُ أَلْفُ دِينَارٍ أَوِ اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفَ دِرْهَمٍ. وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ مَالِك، أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ: أَنَّ فِي كُلِّ زَوْجٍ مِنَ الْإِنْسَانِ الدِّيَةَ كَامِلَةً، وَأَنَّ فِي اللِّسَانِ الدِّيَةَ كَامِلَةً، وَأَنَّ فِي الْأُذُنَيْنِ إِذَا ذَهَبَ سَمْعُهُمَا الدِّيَةَ كَامِلَةً، اصْطُلِمَتَا أَوْ لَمْ تُصْطَلَمَا، وَفِي ذَكَرِ الرَّجُلِ الدِّيَةُ كَامِلَةً، وَفِي الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ الدِّيَةُ كَامِلَةً. وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ مَالِك، أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ: أَنَّ فِي ثَدْيَيِ الْمَرْأَةِ الدِّيَةَ كَامِلَةً. قَالَ مَالِك: وَأَخَفُّ ذَلِكَ عِنْدِي الْحَاجِبَانِ وَثَدْيَا الرَّجُلِ. قَالَ مَالِك: الْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا: أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ إِذَا أُصِيبَ مِنْ أَطْرَافِهِ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ دِيَتِهِ فَذَلِكَ لَهُ إِذَا أُصِيبَتْ يَدَاهُ وَرِجْلَاهُ وَعَيْنَاهُ فَلَهُ ثَلَاثُ دِيَاتٍ. قَالَ مَالِك فِي عَيْنِ الْأَعْوَرِ الصَّحِيحَةِ إِذَا فُقِئَتْ خَطَأً: إِنَّ فِيهَا الدِّيَةَ كَامِلَةً

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated that Zayd ibn Thabit used to say regarding a standing eye when its sight is extinguished: 'One hundred dinars.' Yahya said: Malik was asked about eyelid injury and eye socket. He said: 'There is nothing in that except ijtihad (judicial discretion), unless it decreases the sight of the eye, then he has according to what was decreased from the sight of the eye.' Yahya said: Malik said: 'The matter with us regarding a standing blind eye when its sight is extinguished, and regarding a paralyzed hand when it is cut off, is that there is nothing in that except ijtihad, and there is no specified blood money in that.'
processed_hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ مَالِك، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ، كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي الْعَيْنِ الْقَائِمَةِ إِذَا طَفِئَتْ: مِائَةُ دِينَارٍ. قَالَ يَحْيَى: وَسُئِلَ مَالِك، عَنْ شَتَرِ الْعَيْنِ وَحِجَاجِ الْعَيْنِ؟ فَقَالَ: لَيْسَ فِي ذَلِكَ إِلَّا الْاجْتِهَادُ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَنْقُصَ بَصَرُ الْعَيْنِ فَيَكُونُ لَهُ بِقَدْرِ مَا نَقَصَ مِنْ بَصَرِ الْعَيْنِ. قَالَ يَحْيَى: قَالَ مَالِك: الْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا فِي الْعَيْنِ الْقَائِمَةِ الْعَوْرَاءِ إِذَا طَفِئَتْ، وَفِي الْيَدِ الشَّلَّاءِ إِذَا قُطِعَتْ، إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي ذَلِكَ إِلَّا الْاجْتِهَادُ، وَلَيْسَ فِي ذَلِكَ عَقْلٌ مُسَمًّى

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Yahya narrated to me from Malik, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, that he heard Sulayman ibn Yasar mention: 'That the mudiha (wound exposing bone) on the face is like the mudiha on the head, except that if it disfigures the face, there is added to its compensation what is between it and half the compensation of the mudiha on the head, so in it would be seventy-five dinars.' Malik said: 'And the matter with us is that in the munaqqilah (wound that breaks bone fragments) is fifteen obligations. He said: The munaqqilah is that whose bone fragments fly out and it does not pierce to the brain, and it occurs on the head and on the face.' Malik said: 'The matter agreed upon with us is: That the ma'mumah (wound reaching the brain) and the ja'ifah (wound reaching the body cavity) - there is no qisas (retaliation) in them.'
processed_hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ مَالِك، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ يَذْكُرُ: أَنَّ الْمُوضِحَةَ فِي الْوَجْهِ مِثْلُ الْمُوضِحَةِ فِي الرَّأْسِ، إِلَّا أَنْ تَعِيبَ الْوَجْهَ فَيُزَادُ فِي عَقْلِهَا، مَا بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ عَقْلِ نِصْفِ الْمُوضِحَةِ فِي الرَّأْسِ، فَيَكُونُ فِيهَا خَمْسَةٌ وَسَبْعُونَ دِينَارًا. قَالَ مَالِك: وَالْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا أَنَّ فِي الْمُنَقِّلَةِ خَمْسَ عَشَرَةَ فَرِيضَةً. قَالَ: وَالْمُنَقِّلَةُ الَّتِي يَطِيرُ فِرَاشُهَا مِنَ الْعَظْمِ وَلَا تَخْرِقُ إِلَى الدِّمَاغِ، وَهِيَ تَكُونُ فِي الرَّأْسِ وَفِي الْوَجْهِ. قَالَ مَالِك: الْأَمْرُ الْمُجْتَمَعُ عَلَيْهِ عِنْدَنَا: أَنَّ الْمَأْمُومَةَ وَالْجَائِفَةَ لَيْسَ فِيهِمَا قَوَدٌ

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Ibn Shihab said: 'There is no qisas (retaliation) for the ma'mumah (wound reaching the brain).' Malik said: 'And the ma'mumah is what pierces the bone to the brain, and the ma'mumah only occurs in the head. And what reaches the brain when it pierces the bone.' Malik said: 'The matter with us is that there is no blood money for what is less than the mudiha (wound exposing bone) from wounds, until it reaches the mudiha. And the blood money is only in the mudiha and what is above it. That is because the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ended at the mudiha in his letter to Amr ibn Hazm, and he made in it five camels. And the leaders did not rule in the past nor in recent times regarding what is less than the mudiha with blood money.'
processed_hadiths.arabicText: وَقَدْ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ: لَيْسَ فِي الْمَأْمُومَةِ قَوَدٌ. قَالَ مَالِك: وَالْمَأْمُومَةُ مَا خَرَقَ الْعَظْمَ إِلَى الدِّمَاغِ، وَلَا تَكُونُ الْمَأْمُومَةُ إِلَّا فِي الرَّأْسِ. وَمَا يَصِلُ إِلَى الدِّمَاغِ إِذَا خَرَقَ الْعَظْمَ. قَالَ مَالِك: الْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ الْمُوضِحَةِ مِنَ الشِّجَاجِ عَقْلٌ، حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ الْمُوضِحَةَ، وَإِنَّمَا الْعَقْلُ فِي الْمُوضِحَةِ فَمَا فَوْقَهَا، وَذَلِكَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ انْتَهَى إِلَى الْمُوضِحَةِ فِي كِتَابِهِ لِعَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، فَجَعَلَ فِيهَا خَمْسًا مِنَ الْإِبِلِ، وَلَمْ تَقْضِ الْأَئِمَّةُ فِي الْقَدِيمِ وَلَا فِي الْحَدِيثِ فِيمَا دُونَ الْمُوضِحَةِ بِعَقْلٍ

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Yahya narrated to me from Malik, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, that he said: 'Every penetrating wound in a limb from the limbs, in it is one-third of the blood money of that limb.' Malik narrated to me: 'Ibn Shihab did not see that. And I do not see in a penetrating wound in a limb from the limbs in the body a matter agreed upon, but I see in it ijtihad (judicial discretion); the Imam exercises ijtihad in that, and there is no agreed-upon matter regarding it with us.' Malik said: 'The matter with us is that the ma'mumah, munaqqilah, and mudiha only occur on the face and head. Whatever of that is on the body, there is nothing in it except ijtihad.' Malik said: 'So I do not see the lower jaw and the nose as part of the head in their wounds, because they are two separate bones, and the head after them is one bone.' Yahya narrated to me from Malik, from Rabi'ah ibn Abi Abd al-Rahman, that Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr inflicted qisas (retaliation) for the munaqqilah.
processed_hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ مَالِك، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: كُلُّ نَافِذَةٍ فِي عُضْوٍ مِنَ الْأَعْضَاءِ فَفِيهَا ثُلُثُ عَقْلِ ذَلِكَ الْعُضْوِ. حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك: كَانَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ لَا يَرَى ذَلِكَ. وَأَنَا لَا أَرَى فِي نَافِذَةٍ فِي عُضْوٍ مِنَ الْأَعْضَاءِ فِي الْجَسَدِ أَمْرًا مُجْتَمَعًا عَلَيْهِ، وَلَكِنِّي أَرَى فِيهَا الْاجْتِهَادَ يَجْتَهِدُ الْإِمَامُ فِي ذَلِكَ، وَلَيْسَ فِي ذَلِكَ أَمْرٌ مُجْتَمَعٌ عَلَيْهِ عِنْدَنَا. قَالَ مَالِك: الْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا أَنَّ الْمَأْمُومَةَ وَالْمُنَقِّلَةَ وَالْمُوضِحَةَ لَا تَكُونُ إِلَّا فِي الْوَجْهِ وَالرَّأْسِ فَمَا كَانَ فِي الْجَسَدِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَلَيْسَ فِيهِ إِلَّا الْاجْتِهَادُ. قَالَ مَالِك: فَلَا أَرَى اللَّحْيَ الْأَسْفَلَ وَالْأَنْفَ مِنَ الرَّأْسِ فِي جِرَاحِهِمَا لِأَنَّهُمَا عَظْمَانِ مُنْفَرِدَانِ، وَالرَّأْسُ بَعْدَهُمَا عَظْمٌ وَاحِدٌ. وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ مَالِك، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ أَقَادَ مِنَ الْمُنَقِّلَةِ

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Rabi'ah ibn Abi Abd al-Rahman, that he said: I asked Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib: 'How much is for a woman's finger?' He said: 'Ten camels.' I said: 'How much for two fingers?' He said: 'Twenty camels.' I said: 'How much for three?' He said: 'Thirty camels.' I said: 'How much for four?' He said: 'Twenty camels.' I said: 'When her wound became greater and her affliction more severe, her blood money decreased?' Sa'id said: 'Are you an Iraqi?' I said: 'Rather, a knowledgeable person seeking to verify, or an ignorant person seeking to learn.' Sa'id said: 'It is the Sunnah, O my nephew.' Malik said: 'The matter with us regarding the fingers of the hand when they are cut - their blood money is complete. That is because the five fingers when cut, their blood money is the blood money of the hand: fifty camels, ten camels for each finger.' Malik said: 'And the calculation of the fingers is thirty-three dinars and one-third of a dinar for each joint, and it is from camels three obligations and one-third of an obligation.'
processed_hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ مَالِك، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ: كَمْ فِي إِصْبَعِ الْمَرْأَةِ؟ فَقَالَ: عَشْرٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ، فَقُلْتُ: كَمْ فِي إِصْبَعَيْنِ؟ قَالَ: عِشْرُونَ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ، فَقُلْتُ: كَمْ فِي ثَلَاثٍ؟ فَقَالَ: ثَلَاثُونَ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ، فَقُلْتُ: كَمْ فِي أَرْبَعٍ؟ قَالَ: عِشْرُونَ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ، فَقُلْتُ: حِينَ عَظُمَ جُرْحُهَا وَاشْتَدَّتْ مُصِيبَتُهَا نَقَصَ عَقْلُهَا، فَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ: أَعِرَاقِيٌّ أَنْتَ؟ فَقُلْتُ: بَلْ عَالِمٌ مُتَثَبِّتٌ أَوْ جَاهِلٌ مُتَعَلِّمٌ، فَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ: هِيَ السُّنَّةُ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي. قَالَ مَالِك: الْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا فِي أَصَابِعِ الْكَفِّ إِذَا قُطِعَتْ فَقَدْ تَمَّ عَقْلُهَا، وَذَلِكَ أَنَّ خَمْسَ الْأَصَابِعِ إِذَا قُطِعَتْ كَانَ عَقْلُهَا عَقْلَ الْكَفِّ خَمْسِينَ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ فِي كُلِّ إِصْبَعٍ عَشَرَةٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ. قَالَ مَالِك: وَحِسَابُ الْأَصَابِعِ ثَلَاثَةٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ دِينَارًا، وَثُلُثُ دِينَارٍ فِي كُلِّ أُنْمُلَةٍ وَهِيَ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ ثَلَاثُ فَرَائِضَ وَثُلُثُ فَرِيضَةٍ
